name: limits-forecast
description: Forecasts whether you will hit your 5-hour or weekly usage limit, or a model's own weekly limit (Fable's), before it resets, learns your usage pattern over time and suggests what to change.

line.title: Limits line
line.description: The limits line above the prompt: full, compact (no bars, time or context; forecast and risk under pressure only) or off

toasts.title: Toasts
toasts.description: Toasts when a verdict gets worse and when a window passes 80% and 90%

modelLimits.title: Model limits
modelLimits.description: Show a model's own weekly limit (Fable's). Claude Code reports it to /usage only, so the mod reads it from Anthropic's usage endpoint with your login, at most every 5 minutes. Off: no network calls at all
